name: YNHPROP
recent: YNH Property 的 RM170 million sukuk 因储备金短缺触发技术性违约，MARC Ratings 下调评级并列入负面观察。公司正通过出售 Hartamas 资产等筹资计划安排 2027 年 2 月赎回。最新季度营收同比大跌 81.5%，净亏损扩大至 RM53.0 million。
notable: Sukuk 储备金短缺导致技术性违约，MARC Ratings 下调评级并列入负面观察。
公司计划通过 Hartamas 资产出售筹资 RM105 million，用于 2027 年 2 月 sukuk 赎回。
公司将于 2026 年 11 月 24 日召开第 24 届常年股东大会。
risks: Sukuk 储备金短缺已构成技术性违约，评级被下调。
公司需在 2027 年 2 月前筹集资金赎回 RM170 million sukuk。
最新季度营收同比大跌 81.5%，净亏损扩大。
earnings: 2026 财年第四季度（截至 6 月 30 日）营收为 RM6.9 million，环比下降 47.9%，同比下降 81.5%；净亏损为 RM53.0 million，净亏损率为 766.7%，较上一季度的 95.7% 明显扩大。

recent_en: YNH Property's RM170 million sukuk triggered a technical default due to a reserve shortfall, with MARC Ratings downgrading and placing it on negative watch. The company is arranging funding, including the Hartamas asset sale, for the February 2027 redemption. Latest quarterly revenue fell 81.5% year-on-year, with net loss widening to RM53.0 million.
notable_en: Sukuk reserve shortfall led to a technical default; MARC Ratings downgraded and placed the rating on negative watch.
The company plans to raise RM105 million from the Hartamas asset sale for the February 2027 sukuk redemption.
risks_en: The sukuk reserve shortfall constitutes a technical default, and the rating has been downgraded.
The company needs to raise funds to redeem the RM170 million sukuk by February 2027.
Latest quarterly revenue fell 81.5% year-on-year, with net loss widening.
earnings_en: For the fourth quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM6.9 million, down 47.9% QoQ and 81.5% YoY; net loss was RM53.0 million with a net margin of 766.7%, widening from 95.7% in the previous quarter.
